question: Should the repository adopt Release Drafter autolabeler v7.5.1, including its changed-files path-filtering behavior, in the write-scoped pull-request labeling workflow?
rationale: The patch is mechanically clean, but accepting changed third-party automation behavior and its write-scoped execution requires workflow-owner intent that ordinary CI does not fully establish.

options.title: Accept v7.5.1
options.body: Merge the full-SHA update and verify path-based labeling on the next suitable pull request, coordinating with the companion Release Drafter update where useful.

options.title: Hold v7.4.0
options.body: Keep the current pin until the workflow owner is ready to validate or explicitly decline the new path-filtering semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept v7.5.1
recommendation.body: Merge the full-SHA update and verify path-based labeling on the next suitable pull request, coordinating with the companion Release Drafter update where useful.
